answers.question: What projects will I have in my portfolio by the end?
answers.answer: By the end of the course, you finish with a portfolio of working AI products that people can inspect, including demos, architecture thinking, project decisions, and case studies. Across its four stages, your deliverables are: a validated product brief and prototype, a tested data-backed MVP, a grounded tool-using AI workflow, and a deployed product with an improvement plan. You learn workflows behind full-stack AI products, RAG knowledge layers, MCP integrations, and deployable product systems.

answers.question: Can I automate my customer support and WhatsApp with what I learn here?
answers.answer: Yes. For business owners, the course covers automating operations, support, and reporting. In the MCP, APIs & Integrations module, you learn how to connect AI directly to customer data, analytics, ads, WhatsApp, and the tools where real work happens. You also learn how to build agents and automations to run leaner systems.
